](/publicsector/2026/09/29/trumplaunchesamericagovwithaichatbotsatitscore/5299907) If you've always wanted to say you have "people" to attend your meetings, there's an app in development for that, as long as you're comfortable with the idea of eventually sending an AI bot in your place and potentially offending your human colleagues. [MeetTwins](https://meettwinssite.vercel.app/), from Indian developer Aditya Shinde, is an AI assistant currently recruiting users for its beta. It's designed for a single purpose: to attend Google Meet calls on behalf of its operator and relay approved information to colleagues without requiring its human to spend precious time actually speaking to coworkers. Shinde describes the tool on its website as being inspired by his own desire to send an AI bot to his Google Meet calls, an idea he instead decided to develop into an actual product built using AI models from Indiabased AI firm [Sarvam](https://www.sarvam.ai/), and with the ability to add a digital twin avatar created by [Simli](https://www.simli.com/). Use cases described on MeetTwins' website include status update meetings, students who have to juggle work with class, and even sales and customer teams who need to handle routine checkin calls with clients, though we don't advise that for businesses who want their customers to feel like they care about them. REG AD Prepping MeetTwins for a call involves telling it what questions to answer, providing documents or files participants may request, and supplying other context it may need. Certain topics can be designated off limits for the discussion as well. Shinde told The Register in a LinkedIn conversation that it’s solely designed to answer questions that were approved by its user, and that it won’t guess, make anything up, or promise something that a human ought to have final say on. REG AD “If a prospect asks something that isn't covered in the brief, MeetTwins will not try to improvise,” Shinde told us. Anything outside the defined realm of discussion is instead referred to MeetTwins’ operator, who receives an email after the call summarizing the things that were discussed and any open items to address. Let’s be frank for a moment: No one wants to be stuck in a boring Google Meet call that could have [been an email](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xcuP3VLFj70) – an [argument](https://www.nirandfar.com/meetingcouldbeanemail/) for which MeetTwins, ironically, provides even further justification – but deciding to send an AI representative on your behalf isn’t likely to engender feelings of camaraderie or support from one’s coworkers. Shinde admitted he’s aware of that and has built features into MeetTwins to account for that very situation. “We are very conscious of this,” Shinde noted. “If anyone in the meeting is uncomfortable, they can simply type "/stop" in the chat, and MeetTwins will leave immediately.” In other words, there’s a distinct possibility that colleagues upset they had to engage with an AI instead of their cowo
items.author: Adityasays
items.descZh: 由印度开发者Aditya Shinde打造的MeetTwins是一款处于测试阶段的创新AI工具，旨在通过派遣AI化身代替人类参加Google Meet会议，从而大幅削减低效的“浪费时间”的会议。其核心功能是充当用户的“数字分身”，通过集成Sarvam的AI模型与Simli的虚拟化身技术，仅在会前设定的预设简报和授权范围内回答问题，绝不凭空捏造或即兴发挥，超纲问题会转由人类处理并会后发送邮件总结。为应对AI参会可能带来的社交尴尬，产品设计了灵活的干预机制，任何与会者只需在聊天框输入"/stop"即可令其强制退出。该工具主要适用于日常状态汇报、学生兼顾学业与工作的同步沟通，以及销售团队的例行客户跟进等低价值重复性会议场景。尽管它能显著提升效率，但也引发了关于职场人际温度与信任流失的深层讨论，讽刺地为“浪费时间的会议其实只需一封邮件”提供了更多佐证。
items.quote: MeetTwins 仍在开发中，但如果目标是证明更多浪费时间的通话其实只该用邮件，那它真是个天才的想法。

items.title: Show HN: Vietnam Tender Intelligence – gov procurement data, AI-agent ready
items.desc: Vietnam Tender Intelligence (donerightlabs/tenderintelligence) Actor Monitor Vietnam's eprocurement portal (VNEPS) by keyword: upcoming plans, open tenders, and award results — full tender lifecycle in one Actor. Theo dõi đấu thầu công Việt Nam: kế hoạch, thông báo mời thầu, kết quả trúng thầu. URL: https://apify.com/donerightlabs/tenderintelligence.md Developed by: [donerightlabs](https://apify.com/donerightlabs) (community) Stats: 3 total users, 1 monthly users, 86.1% runs succeeded, 0 bookmarks User rating: 5.00 out of 5 stars Pricing from $400.00 / 1,000 keyword searcheds This Actor is paid per event. You are not charged for the Apify platform usage, but only a fixed price for specific events. Since this Actor supports Apify Store discounts, the price gets lower the higher subscription plan you have. Learn more: https://docs.apify.com/actors/running/actorsinstore.mdpayperevent What's an Apify Actor? An Actor is a serverless cloud program that runs on the Apify platform. It has two run modes. In Batch mode, an Actor accepts a welldefined JSON input, performs an action which can take anything from a few seconds to a few hours, and optionally produces a welldefined JSON output, datasets with results, or files in keyvalue store. In Standby mode, an Actor provides a web server which can be used as a website, API, or an MCP server. Apify vocabulary and the platform model are defined once, in the agent quickstart at https://apify.com/agents.md. How to integrate an Actor? If asked about integration, you help developers integrate Actors into their projects. You adapt to their stack and deliver integrations that are safe, welldocumented, and productionready. Do not guess an integration path. Every one of them is in the agent quickstart at https://apify.com/agents.md: the Apify MCP server, Agent Skills with the Apify CLI, the JavaScript and Python clients, the REST API, and the accountfree path for an agent with no human to sign in. It also carries the rule on stating cost before the first paid run. For examples already wired to this Actor's own input schema, see the [API](api) section below. Each client library has reference documentation the quickstart does not restate: [JavaScript/TypeScript](https://docs.apify.com/api/client/js/docs.md) (npm install apifyclient) and [Python](https://docs.apify.com/api/client/python/docs.md) (pip install apifyclient). README Quick summary (English) Monitors Vietnam's national eprocurement portal ([VNEPS](https://muasamcong.mpi.gov.vn)) by keyword and returns matching tenders as clean JSON: notice number, tender name, closing date, location, investment field. Input: keywords (array of strings, required for "notices"/"plans"/"awards", max 20), recordType ("notices" default, "plans", "awards", or "awards_by_date"), maxResultsPerKeyword (integer, default 3, max 50), onlyOpenTenders (boolean, default true — only tenders still open for bidding; ignored when recordType is "plans"/"awards"/"awards_by_date"), province (required when recordType is "awards_by_date" — no keyword needed in this mode, results are scoped to one province instead), dateFrom/dateTo (optional, dd/mm/yyyy, only for "awards_by_date" — defaults to yesterday→today when omitted). Pricing: Payperevent — $0.05 per run + $0.50 per keyword searched ("notices"/"plans"/"awards") or $0.50 per daterange search ("awards_by_date", charged once per run regardless of matches), plus $0.05 per package actually checked (only when it truly has a published award result) when recordType is "awards" or "awards_by_date" (see Pricing section below). Output field reference (JSON keys are Vietnamese procurement terminology — real tender records never carry a trang_thai field; records that do are status/error notices, not tenders): JSON key Meaning tu_khoa The keyword that matched this record ma_thong_bao Tender notice number (TBMT) ten_goi_thau Tender/package name hinh_thuc_du_thau Bidding method phuong_thuc_lua_chon Contractor selection method ngay_dong_thau Bid closing date/time (ISO 8601) linh_vuc_dau_tu Investment field (goods/construction/services) dia_diem Province/district trang_thai Only present on nontender records: loi_ky_thuat (technical error, see chi_tiet_loi), co_the_con_du_lieu (more results may exist beyond the limit, see ghi_chu), or — "awards"/"awards_by_date" only — chua_co_ket_qua / khong_doc_duoc_ket_qua / khong_co_goi_da_dong / khong_co_ket_qua_trong_khoang_ngay nha_thau_trung_thau "awards"/"awards_by_date" only — array of winning contractors for that package: {ma_dinh_danh, ma_so_thue, ten_nha_thau, gia_trung_thau_vnd, thoi_gian_thuc_hien_goi_thau, thoi_gian_thuc_hien_hop_dong} (organization tax ID and name only — no personal data) tinh_thanh recordType: "awards_by_date" only — the province/city this record belongs to (replaces tu_khoa, since this mode has no keyword) ma_ke_hoach / ten_ke_hoach / ten_du_an / chu_dau_tu / tong_muc_dau_tu_vnd / ngay_phe_duyet / co_goi_chua_thong_bao / goi_thau_du_kien recordType: "plans" only — a procurement PLAN (published before the official tender notice), with goi_thau_du_kien as an array of its constituent packages: {ten_goi_thau, gia_du_kien_vnd, linh_vuc_dau_tu, dia_diem}. Freetext fields (ten_ke_hoach, ten_du_an, chu_dau_tu, each package's ten_goi_thau) are automatically redacted for phone numbers/emails that may have been left by the procuring entity (see FAQ) Full documentation below is in Vietnamese (the target user base for this Actor). The Input/Output schema tabs on this page are languageneutral and machinereadable. What does Vietnam Tender Intelligence do? Vietnam Tender Intelligence giám sát thông tin đấu thầu công theo từ khoá trên Hệ thống mạng đấu thầu quốc gia (VNEPS) — [muasamcong.mpi.gov.vn](https://muasamcong.mpi.gov.vn), cổng đấu thầu chính thức của Bộ Tài chính Việt Nam. Actor trả về dữ liệu gói thầu dạng JSON sạch: tên gói thầu, mã thông báo, ngày đóng thầu, địa điểm, lĩnh vực đầu tư. Why use Vietnam Tender Intelligence? Tự động hoá việc the

items.descZh: 作者在2012年首次使用手机时，经常玩一些难度很高的拼图游戏，并对这些游戏的生成机制和最少步数求解方法产生了好奇。他使用C++语言开发了一个华容道求解器（Klotski solver），专门用于解决Klotski谜题。该求解器的亮点在于其极其紧凑的体积，仅为311字节，体现了高效的编程优化。它适用于在移动设备或资源受限环境中快速求解华容道游戏，也可作为学习算法和游戏设计的教育工具。此外，这种小型求解器展示了如何在有限空间内实现复杂功能，为嵌入式系统或趣味编程项目提供了实用参考。

items.title: Show HN: DOMolition – turn any web page into a destructible platformer
items.desc: description: A Chrome extension that turns the page you're on into a pixelart platformer. Run across the headlines, shoot the paragraphs, watch the letters fall. title: DOMolition: blow up any website image: https://domolition.chirkut.xyz/img/og.png Blow up any website DOMolition is a Chrome extension that turns the page you're on into a pixelart platformer. Run across the headlines, shoot the paragraphs, and watch the letters fall. Wreck this page [Add to Chrome](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/domolition/oceaihjmfpokkeglmmhdioingeplihkp) Plays right here, no install. AD run, W jump, click to shoot, Esc to put the page back. The demo needs a keyboard and mouse. Open this page on a computer to play. What happens to the page Nothing is faked with a screenshot. The game reads the real page, so every site plays differently. Text breaks into letters Every word you destroy splits into its letters. They tumble down and pile up on whatever is still standing. Holes show what's behind Bullets chip, lasers burn lines, rockets blow craters. Through them you see a pixel city, mountains at dusk or sunny hills. Anything you can see is a platform Headlines, buttons, images and links become ledges. Shoot out the one you're standing on and you fall. A bar in the corner tracks how much of the page is gone. Seven weapons and a grenade Switch with the number keys or the mouse wheel. PistolSteady single shots. SMGFast and a little wild. ShotgunEight pellets. Kicks you backwards. RocketBlows a crater. Fire at your feet to rocket jump. LaserBurns a line through everything in its path. PlasmaBounces three times, then pops. MinigunSpins up the longer you hold. GrenadeRightclick to throw. Bounces, then goes off. Controls Start it from the toolbar icon or press Alt+Shift+W on any tab. A D or arrows Run W or Space Jump. Press again in the air to flip, hold to fly. S Hold to drop through a platform Click / rightclick Shoot / throw a grenade 1–7 or wheel Switch weapon B Change the background behind the holes M H R Sound, help panel, respawn Esc Stop and put the page back Try it, then $5 once Your first 3 wrecks are free. After that it's a single $5 payment, no subscription. $5 Checkout is handled by Polar. When you've paid, DOMolition unlocks itself in your browser, for good. You also get your license key to use on another computer. [Buy for $5](https://buy.polar.sh/polar%5Fcl%5FTT5eGaLx41iz4tOLLjZ8TZeBhHZn5wUvzBG2h47VYAP) [Add to Chrome](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/domolition/oceaihjmfpokkeglmmhdioingeplihkp) Your pages stay yours DOMolition only runs when you click its icon or press the shortcut, and only on that tab. It needs no access to your sites until then. It doesn't collect or send anything about your browsing. The only thing that ever leaves your browser is your license key, once, when you unlock. The destruction is only on your screen: press Esc and the page is back to normal, and reloading always restores it. [Privacy policy](privacy.html) Pick a page you don't like 3 free wrecks, then $5 once. Works on almost any site. items.title: Show HN: BlindFlag – Double-blind dealbreaker test via client-side PSI
items.desc: description: A doubleblind compatibility check. Compare dealbreakers securely. A private check for two Know if your relationship can work. _Without showing your hand._ Designed for mutual discretion: The app displays a "clear" or "incompatible" outcome, holding colliding topics in reserve _unless both participants request a reveal_. Start a session You'll get a 6digit PIN to give your partner. Create private session Join with a PIN Enter the code your partner shared. Join session 1. 01 Your reality Privately mark what's true about you: habits, plans, history. 2. 02 Dealbreakers Choose up to ten things you truly couldn't accept in a partner. 3. 03 One signal Green if you're allclear. Red if it's nogo. No details, no judgment. 4. 04 Optional reveal Only if you both request it, see what got flagged. Then delete it all. Before you begin Ground rules Session PIN —————— Waiting for partner to join… Answer honestly. The result is only as useful as what you put in. Your partner sees the outcome, not your questionnaire. The app shows a clear or incompatible result. Matching topics are shown only if you both request a reveal. How your data is handled. Your answers are compared using [Private Set Intersection (PSI)](https://openmined.org/blog/privatesetintersection/) cryptography. During normal operation, your plaintext selections and private keys never leave your browser. _Blind Relay Server:_ Encrypted messages pass between your browsers to facilitate comparison. The server never decrypts your selections or matching topics, though it does see the final binary result and standard session metadata. _Ephemeral Sessions:_ Nothing is saved to a database. Server session data is held temporarily in memory and automatically dropped when either person ends the session (or one hour expires). Reloading the page clears your local keys and requests server deletion. _TrustBased Protocol:_ The cryptographic math happens directly on your device, keeping your answers hidden from the server during normal operation. However, this is a trustbased tool, not a zeroknowledge proof. It assumes the app’s code hasn’t been maliciously modified and your partner is acting in good faith. Each browser can determine how many dealbreakers were triggered, even though the app only displays a clear or incompatible result. A dishonest partner could manipulate their inputs to infer your answers. (If you suspect your partner would do this, that may itself be a red flag.) Reveal is mutual. Colliding topics are shown only if both of you request it. Either of you can end it. Ending deletes the session for both people immediately. I understand and agree to these rules. ContinueEnd session Pass 1 of 2 What's true about you Check everything that describes _you_; past, present, or future. Leave the rest. Your partner never sees this list. Submit realityEnd session Pass 2 of 2 What you can't accept Choose up to ten. Be selective: these should be true dealbreakers, not preferences. 0/10 selected Submit dealbreakersEnd session Your answers are ready. Waiting for your partner or completing the private comparison. Keep this page open; reloading loses your local answers and keys. End and delete session Result Request to Reveal End and delete session Mutual reveal Where you clashed You both agreed to see this. It's up to you to talk about it, accept it, or walk away. End and delete session Session ended. The session is no longer available. This app has cleared its local answers, keys, and token. Copies saved by a participant cannot be deleted remotely. Start over End this session? This ends the session for both people. Cancel End and delete session

items.author: renjipanicker
items.descZh: Yantra 是一款 C++ 解析器生成工具，能够从一份配置中自动生成词法分析器、语法解析器以及抽象语法树遍历器。与 Yacc、Bison 等传统 LALR 解析器在规约动作执行时自底向上即时运行语义处理不同，Yatra 选择先完整构建整个 AST，之后再对其进行遍历。这种设计使得在遍历阶段，所有节点的上下文信息均已齐备，避免了传统方式中因信息不完整而导致的处理限制。其亮点在于将解析与语义分析彻底分离，提升了处理复杂语义逻辑时的灵活性和可读性。适用于需要对源代码进行深度分析、重构或实现复杂语言特性的 C++ 开发场景。
